component.name: Station Manager
component.summary: A suite of desktop apps for amateur radio operators

description.p: Station Manager is a collection of Linux desktop applications for amateur radio operators. The suite includes a QSO logging app, a logbook viewer, and CLI utilities. Built with Go, SvelteKit, and the Wails framework.
Designed for offline-first operation — no internet connection is required. Online forwarding to QRZ.com and other services is optional and configurable.
Initial release of Station Manager snap package.
